chapter_title_en: A Storm Rising Overseas — Divine Thunder Bamboo
chapter_seo_title: Han Li Counter-Charms the Sublime Sound Sect: Divine Thunder Bamboo Appears!
chapter_meta_description: Han Li sells a mountain of beast materials, wins a psychological duel against a charm master, and learns the location of the legendary Divine Thunder Bamboo. Nothing comes free in the Mortal Stream.
og_title: Han Li’s Cold Eyes Shatter a Charm Technique — and a Legendary Bamboo Appears
og_description: A tea house negotiation turns into a quiet power struggle. Han Li out-bluffs the Sublime Sound Sect and earns a lead on the Divine Thunder Bamboo — one of the Three Great Sacred Trees.
twitter_title: Han Li nearly falls to a charm technique — then flips it into reverse. The Sublime Sound Sect learns a painful lesson.
twitter_description: A tea house deal, a hidden Core Formation guard, and a piece of the legendary Divine Thunder Bamboo. Standard Tuesday for our favorite mortal cultivator.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the Three Great Sacred Trees in the RMJI setting, also known as Heavenly Thunder Bamboo. A lightning-attuned spiritual wood that can be used to refine top-grade magic treasures. Thought to be extinct.
The forced reversal of a magical or charm technique back into the caster’s own channels, causing internal injury. A sign that the target’s willpower is too strong to influence.
A refined form of soul-maze art that relies on eye contact and subtle emotional manipulation to plant long-term psychological seeds in a target.
The left envoy of the Sublime Sound Sect, a polite, persistent negotiator who hides sharp calculation behind a sweet and humble facade.
Han Li’s soulless Core Formation enforcer, a mute and expressionless giant whose sudden appearance serves as a silent trump card.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened when Madam Fan tried to charm Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She cast a subtle soul-maze technique through eye contact, hoping to make Han Li more pliable over time. Han Li instantly recognized it, countered with sheer cold willpower, and reversed the energy—causing her to suffer art backlash and cough blood.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li keep Qu Hun hidden until after the deal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was saving Qu Hun as a silent deterrent. Revealing a Core Formation asset too early would have changed Madam Fan’s risk calculus before the material negotiation concluded. Using him *after* the deal makes the threat clear without escalating the conflict.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Divine Thunder Bamboo real or just a bait?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is real, but it comes with a catch: the Sublime Sound Sect’s shipment was stolen, and they are gathering allies to reclaim it. Anyone who wants the bamboo must join a very dangerous counter-raid.
